_doc: Genesis plugin enforcement — DORMANT BY DEFAULT. Genesis must NOT touch a normal Claude Code session; it only acts on its OWN agents (sensei/method) when they actually run, and is entered on demand via the /genesis command. So there is NO SessionStart main-thread injection and NO main-thread Stop enforcement here (those made every session run as Sensei + forced APPLIED-EXPERTISE globally). inject fires only on SubagentStart for sensei/method; validate+review fire only on SubagentStop for sensei/method. gate (PreToolUse Write|Edit) and enforce_research (PreToolUse Bash) fire session-wide because PreToolUse matchers key on the TOOL name, not the agent — so those two SCRIPTS self-guard: they no-op unless the payload's agent_type is a genesis agent (see gate.js / enforce_research.js). Each hook derives the active agent from the payload's `agent_type` (verified: code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks). ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is the runtime-substituted absolute plugin path (read-only, version-churned ~14 days after update — runtime data is written under the PROJECT's .genesis/, never here). Interpreter is node: the hooks are Node (.js). The memory server is launched via `npx -y @atiqul/genesis-memory-server` in .mcp.json — no Python anywhere.
